reviews.quote: The affordable tablet lags behind in the most important area. Pros: fast SoC, hardly any heat dissipation, premium case. Cons: thick bezels, a slow 60 Hz screen, the panel is not completely laminated, only a 12-month guarantee, only a few Bluetooth audio codecs, only USB 2.0.

praises: The sensible default: 256GB stops the 'storage almost full' nag that kills 128GB owners after a year (r/ipad, BBY reviews)
A16 handles Genshin, video editing in CapCut, and a full dock of school apps without slowdown
Landscape 12MP front camera + Center Stage is superb on Zoom/Teams
Magic Keyboard Folio detaches in one motion — tablet for reading, laptop for writing
8-9h real battery comfortably covers a full class/work day (BBY reviews)
complaints: Non-laminated display: air gap makes the Pencil feel like it floats above the page and reflections wash the image
No Apple Intelligence — this is the only current iPad excluded
USB 2.0 transfers: moving 100GB of video off the iPad takes an hour-plus
Folio keyboard has no trackpad and keys are unlit
60Hz panel after two years of 120Hz on every rival mid-range tablet and phone

design_philosophy: The volume seller of the entire iPad family: Apple's 'everyone should own an iPad' config, sized at the storage most people actually need. With the Magic Keyboard Folio it is deliberately positioned against Chromebooks and cheap Windows convertibles as the easy, all-day-battery laptop substitute for students and households.
